SR2E.Settings.manualTable.Name: Manual table
SR2E.Settings.manualTable.Hint: The system automates nothing your table might want to do by hand: nothing applied or resisted by itself, no windows popping up for others, no floating damage, no Karma Pool refresh by itself, no IC launched by itself, no token stopped at a ward. Rolls, cards and buttons all still work: people press Apply themselves. The settings below keep their values; turning this off gives them all back.
SR2E.Settings.automationMenu.Name: Automation
SR2E.Settings.automationMenu.Label: Automation
SR2E.Settings.automationMenu.Hint: What the system does by itself (dice and chat, combat and damage, tokens, bookkeeping) in one window, with the master switch Manual table. Apart from the house rules.
SR2E.Automation.title: SR2e: Automation
SR2E.Automation.offWhileManual: Off while Manual table is on (reads as: {value}).
SR2E.Automation.intro: What the system does by itself. World settings (marked World) are the GM's; the others are yours, on this browser or on any browser.
SR2E.Automation.rulesHint: Automation in the rules themselves: change these in the house rules. Manual table overrides them as shown.
SR2E.Automation.Hint.rollAtOnce: A click on a roll button rolls straight away with the window's defaults (Shift-click opens the window).
SR2E.Automation.Hint.oneRollWindow: Opening a roll window closes the other open ones.
SR2E.Automation.Hint.rememberRolls: Roll windows bring back your last choices (Force, pool dice) for the same roll.
SR2E.Automation.Hint.foldDice: Chat cards show their dice folded away.
SR2E.Automation.Hint.typedDice: Type in the results of physical dice instead of rolling them.
SR2E.Automation.Hint.rerollInPlace: A re-roll updates its card instead of posting a new one.
SR2E.Automation.Hint.soundCues: Sounds on your turn, when your characters are attacked or hit, on disasters and alerts.
SR2E.Automation.Hint.defendPrompt: When your character is attacked: a window, a notification, or nothing.
SR2E.Automation.Hint.autoApplyGm: The GM's client applies a few harmless GM-only changes from players' cards by itself.
SR2E.Automation.Hint.autoResistNpc: NPCs nobody plays resist damage and spells by themselves.
SR2E.Automation.Hint.floatingDamage: Damage and healing float over the token as numbers.
SR2E.Automation.Hint.turnPing: The canvas pings the token whose turn it is; you are told when it is yours.
SR2E.Automation.Hint.regionDetect: Someone walks into a watched region: a GM card, a detection roll by itself, or nothing.
SR2E.Automation.Hint.wardsStopAstral: Anything with an astral presence moving across a ward's edge: stopped, warned, or let through.
SR2E.Automation.Hint.hoverCard: Hovering a token you own shows its pools, monitors, initiative and state.
SR2E.Automation.Hint.approvalQueue: Players' purchases, additions and Karma spending wait for the GM's approval.
SR2E.Automation.Rule.KARMA__refresh: Karma Pools refresh on their own
SR2E.Automation.Rule.GEAR__cyberDamage__: Cyberware damage check after heavy hits
SR2E.Automation.Rule.SECURITY_V61__sheaf: Sheaf steps launch their IC by themselves
SR2E.Automation.Rule.TN_AUTO__perception: Perception of someone who can't be seen
SR2E.Automation.presetNone: This world matches none of the presets. A preset changes nothing until you confirm its list of changes.
SR2E.Automation.gmOnly: Only a GM can apply a preset.
SR2E.Automation.Preset.bookHint: The SR2E Book Rules, no house-rule overrides, every automation setting at its default, Manual table off.
SR2E.Automation.Preset.urrHint: The SR2E Unified Rules Revamp, no house-rule overrides (automation left as it is).
SR2E.Automation.Preset.lightHint: The Book Rules with the system only helping: nothing applied or resisted by itself, the defend window and floating damage on, region detection as a GM card, wards warn instead of stopping tokens.
